brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished a two-story residential building in Qalundia village northwest of occupied Jerusalem on Monday morning, Shehab Wire reported. According to activist Mahmoud Awadallah, the forces raided the "al-Bariyat" area of the village before carrying out the demolition operation.

The demolition occurred as tensions persist in Palestinian communities surrounding Jerusalem. Qalundia, located north of the city, has experienced repeated Israeli military operations and home demolitions. The village sits near a checkpoint that controls movement between Jerusalem and the northern West Bank.
